query: What power-simulation design (range of ICCs, expected effect sizes, attrition scenarios) will justify a 200–400 team target and determine pilot sample size?

response.query: What power-simulation design (range of ICCs, expected effect sizes, attrition scenarios) will justify a 200–400 team target and determine pilot sample size?
response.answer: For a 200–400 team target, use an ICC range of 0.05-0.1, expected effect sizes of 0.3-0.5, and attrition rates of 10-20% to determine pilot sample size. Aim for 300-400 teams initially.
